exercises.title: Slide check: promises, async/await, fetch and axios
exercises.problemHtml:
Ten questions on Slot 19: the three states of a Promise, escaping callback hell, how async/await works, running async code in useEffect, and the practical differences between fetch and axios.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mười câu về Slot 19: ba trạng thái của Promise, thoát callback hell, async/await hoạt động thế nào, chạy code async trong useEffect, và khác biệt thực tế giữa fetch và axios.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: promises, async/await, fetch and axios — answer key

1. The three states of a Promise:
   Answer: b) pending, fulfilled, rejected
   Once settled it never changes again. / Đã settle thì không đổi nữa.

2. What does an async function return?
   Answer: b) Always a Promise
   return 5 inside async ⇒ Promise resolving to 5. / return 5 trong async ⇒ Promise resolve ra 5.

3. How do you handle errors with async/await?
   Answer: b) try { await … } catch (e) { … }
   A rejected awaited promise throws at the await. / Promise bị reject sẽ ném lỗi tại chỗ await.

4. fetch("/api/x") gets a 404. The promise…
   Answer: b) resolves with res.ok === false
   Only network failures reject. / Chỉ lỗi mạng mới reject.

5. With fetch, reading the JSON body requires…
   Answer: b) await res.json()
   axios puts it in res.data instead. / axios đặt sẵn ở res.data.

6. Sending JSON with fetch needs… (choose all)
   Answer: a) method: "POST" + b) headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } + c) body: JSON.stringify(data)
   axios.post(url, data) does all three for you. / axios.post(url, data) làm cả ba giúp bạn.

7. axios rejects when…
   Answer: b) the status is outside 2xx, or the network fails
   err.response.status tells you which code. / err.response.status cho biết mã nào.

8. Correct way to fetch in useEffect:
   Answer: b) useEffect(() => { const load = async () => { … }; load(); }, [])
   The effect must return nothing or a cleanup, not a Promise. / Effect phải trả về không gì hoặc cleanup, không phải Promise.

9. Promise.all([a, b]) rejects when…
   Answer: b) any one rejects
   Use Promise.allSettled to get every outcome. / Dùng Promise.allSettled để nhận mọi kết quả.

10. Which is an advantage of axios over fetch?
   Answer: b) Automatic JSON, errors on bad status, instances with baseURL, interceptors
   fetch needs no install; axios saves boilerplate. / fetch không cần cài; axios bớt code lặp.

exercises.title: Event loop: order the console output
exercises.problemHtml:
Code:

console.log("A");
setTimeout(() => console.log("B"), 0);
Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log("C"));
(async () => { console.log("D"); await null; console.log("E"); })();
console.log("F");

Put the letters in the order they are printed.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Event loop: order the console output — answer key

1. Order of output
   Answer: A) A  →  D) D  →  F) F  →  C) C  →  E) E  →  B) B
   Synchronous first (A, D, F), then microtasks in queue order (C, E), then the timer (B). / Đồng bộ trước (A, D, F), rồi microtask theo thứ tự (C, E), rồi hẹn giờ (B).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A, D, F (đồng bộ) → C, E (microtask theo thứ tự xếp hàng) → B (macrotask).

cauHoi.giaiThich:
Synchronous first (A, D, F), then microtasks in queue order (C, E), then the timer (B).

🇻🇳 Đồng bộ trước (A, D, F), rồi microtask theo thứ tự (C, E), rồi hẹn giờ (B).
